findings.description: The historical 123-test receipt includes filename-layout coverage, but its amendment verifier, rules, status and amendment-test hashes differ from the current files. The final six-command security matrix has matching current source pins and intact logs, but does not execute test_amendment_file_layout.py or the declared mirror suite. Current amendment tests cover the verification changes, but the supplied evidence does not explicitly establish that the historical layout and mirror results remain valid across those changes. Functional evidence is therefore incomplete; this is not a demonstrated implementation failure.
findings.required_evidence: Current execution evidence for the uncovered cases, or a bounded dependency-impact assessment establishing why their historical results remain applicable. No tests were run or files modified during this review.
